Complete original bootstrap and five exact unresolved needs, context-only permission owns no answers.
Final anonymous request, actual raw answers/corrections, final context and durable prediction sink; preserve result identity and complete declaration with anonymous view hash.

Half-open threshold inversion; positive numeric runway misread as favorable category.
Need deletion/paraphrase/full answered disposition despite context-only result.
